fact.sentence: RAG 把检索文档视为潜变量，端到端训练检索器与生成器，并提出 RAG-Sequence（各目标词共用同一文档）与 RAG-Token（各目标词可依据不同文档）两种边缘化方式[2, p.3]
fact.source_quote:
To train the retriever and generator end-to-end, we treat the retrieved document as a latent variable.
We propose two models that marginalize over the latent documents in different ways to produce a
distribution over generated text. In one approach, RAG-Sequence, the model uses the same document
to predict each target token. The second approach, RAG-Token, can predict each target token based
on a different document.
fact.reason: 该段逐字说明端到端训练检索器与生成器、把检索文档视为潜变量，并定义RAG-Sequence与RAG-Token两种边缘化方式，直接支持该句。

fact.sentence: RETRO 进一步把检索器固定：以冻结 BERT 嵌入为键、原始文本块为值构建键值库，避免周期性重训检索网络[4, p.2]
fact.source_quote:
Our method ﬁrst
constructs a key-value database, where values store raw chunks of text tokens and keys are frozen
Bert embedddings (Devlin et al., 2019). We use a frozen model to avoid having to periodically
fact.reason: 该段逐字说明键值库以原始文本块为值、冻结BERT嵌入为键，并使用冻结模型以避免周期性重训，支持该句。

fact.sentence: Self-RAG 不训练新的稠密检索器，而是训练任意 LM 生成反思标记，把检索与相关性判断统一为扩展词表上的下一词预测[5, p.2]
fact.source_quote:
SELF-RAG trains an arbitrary LM to generate text with reflection tokens by unifying them as the
next token prediction from the expanded model vocabulary.
fact.reason: 该段逐字说明Self-RAG训练任意LM通过扩展词表上的下一词预测生成反思标记，支持该句关于训练方式的部分；该段未直接提及“不训练新的稠密检索器”，但整句核心机制有逐字支持。

fact.sentence: 在 FEVER 上它把类别映射为单 token 直接训练，且不使用检索证据监督[2, p.5]
fact.source_quote:
We map FEVER
class labels (supports, refutes, or not enough info) to single output tokens and directly train with
claim-class pairs. Crucially, unlike most other approaches to FEVER, we do not use supervision on
retrieved evidence.
fact.reason: 该段逐字说明将FEVER类别映射为单token直接训练，且不使用检索证据监督，直接支持该句。

fact.sentence: RETRO 的主战场是语言建模：在 2 万亿 token 数据库上以约少 25 倍的参数取得与 GPT-3、Jurassic-1 在 Pile 上可比的性能，并称微调后可迁移到知识密集型问答[4, p.1]
fact.source_quote:
With a 2 trillion token database, our
Retrieval-Enhanced Transformer (Retro) obtains comparable performance to GPT-3 and Jurassic-1
on the Pile, despite using 25× fewer parameters. After ﬁne-tuning, Retro performance translates to
downstream knowledge-intensive tasks such as question answering.
fact.reason: 该段逐字说明2万亿token数据库、以少25倍参数在Pile上与GPT-3和Jurassic-1可比，微调后迁移到知识密集型问答，直接支持该句。

fact.sentence: 其对比显示在 PubHealth、PopQA、传记生成与 ASQA 等任务上优于监督微调 LLM，并在部分任务上超过 ChatGPT[5, p.8]
